title: Load a recorded screenshot
responsibility: Loads the selected runtime screenshot for the shown project and commit, reports its loading state, and releases the image when the view is finished.

inputs.name: recordedPreview.workspace
inputs.description: Supplies the project and commit context plus the bridge used to read evidence and artifact bytes. Without an evidence-capable bridge, the preview is reported as missing.

inputs.name: recordedPreview.entityId
inputs.description: Identifies the entity whose after-state screenshot is selected and is checked against the returned evidence scope. Evidence for another entity or commit is reported as an error.

inputs.name: recordedPreview.thumbnail
inputs.description: Carries recorded preview metadata; if any of scenario, state, or viewport is set, all three must be set. With none set, the implementation searches the evidence registry for a required state covering the entity and an associated screenshot viewport.

inputs.name: recordedPreview.apply
inputs.description: Receives a PreviewState immediately with status loading, followed by ready, missing, or error when a live result is available. Cleanup suppresses later updates.

outputs.name: stop
outputs.description: Call this cleanup function to mark the preview disposed and revoke any object URL already created. It does not cancel an in-flight evidence or artifact request.

errors.name: Recorded evidence entity or commit mismatch
errors.description: Thrown when the evidence result names a different entity or commit than the requested scope. The asynchronous handler catches it and reports an error state through apply unless cleanup has run.

errors.name: Recorded evidence project mismatch
errors.description: Thrown when the requested project differs from the project in the evidence identity. The asynchronous handler catches it and reports an error state through apply unless cleanup has run.

errors.name: Recorded evidence source commit mismatch
errors.description: Thrown when the evidence identity source commit differs from the requested commit. The asynchronous handler catches it and reports an error state through apply unless cleanup has run.

errors.name: Incomplete recorded thumbnail identity
errors.description: Thrown when a recorded thumbnail supplies only some of scenario, state, and viewport. The asynchronous handler catches it and reports an error state through apply unless cleanup has run.

errors.name: Unsupported preview image type
errors.description: Thrown when the fetched artifact media type is neither image/png nor image/jpeg. The asynchronous handler catches it and reports an error state through apply unless cleanup has run.
